items.title: The screenshot is not the product
items.content_text:

A gorgeous dashboard screenshot proves almost nothing. The real design test arrives at 4:47pm, when one number is wrong, one source is late, and somebody needs to decide whether to wait, call, or stop the machine. Polished ambiguity is still ambiguity. It just has better shadows.
